items.text: Tampa Bay (early week): Baker Mayfield played through foot/thumb in Wk11, expected to start. CB Benjamin Morrison (hamstring) and CB Jacob Parrish (back) had MRIs Monday, results pending; DL Elijah Simmons in concussion protocol. IR - WR Jalen McMillan.
Carolina (early week): WR Jalen Coker cleared concussion protocol; no other new injuries. Bryce Young starts. IR - RB Jonathan Brooks.
